resources.string: Changes apply the next time Android starts.
Lets the threads of an app run at the same time. Warm launches got faster in tests, cold launches slower.
Keep running while the screen is off

Turns off system apps that have nothing to do here (Bluetooth, NFC, telephony extras, printing, …) and compiles the always-running apps ahead of time, once, in the background after the first boot with it on. Faster boots, less background work. Turning it off brings them back.
Fill the whole screen (about 25% more drawing)
Extra navigation buttons below the screen
This deletes Android 17 and everything in it (apps, settings, files). Installing again downloads 1.2 GB.
If Android 17 stops on its own, turn on Developer options → \"Disable child process restrictions\" (Android 14 and later) and close other heavy apps.
